facts.fact: 街景对比：每家小餐馆/潜水吧/破店旁都有一家贵的 counterpart——新钱建给新钱花。
facts.anchor: For every diner, dive, and dinky shop there was one from the other side too

facts.fact: 旧皮卡旁每四五辆就有一辆崭新的德国车——车在说「我不是本地人」「我不属于这里」。
facts.anchor: Something that said, I’m not from here. Something that said, I don’t belong.

facts.fact: 新公路绕镇西侧——造价数百万、谁游说的？她怀疑每根线都通向 Dunning 地产公司。
facts.anchor: A brand-new highway that circled Dunning on the west side

facts.fact: 旅馆：无网站、独立经营、破旧——现金双倍价、不留 ID 不刷卡。
facts.anchor: One with no website, independently run, run-down and tired.

facts.fact: 安全仪式一：门楔踢进门槛下、伸缩臂顶住把手防转动。
facts.anchor: kicking it underneath and then extending the telescopic arm up into the handle

facts.fact: 安全仪式二：鳄鱼夹封窗帘、双面胶贴墙——没人能偷看。
facts.anchor: clipping them shut and tacking them to the walls with double-sided sticky pads

facts.fact: 安全仪式三：检测笔验镜面不放心——毯子盖住镜子、图钉钉死；偷看者只能看见黑。
facts.anchor: tucked it behind the frame of the mirror affixed to the wall and pinned it in place with some thumbtacks

facts.fact: 安全仪式四：RF 探测器扫房确认无录音设备。
facts.anchor: ran an RF detector around the room to make sure there was no active recording equipment

facts.fact: Tom 提议换 Reilly 接手——Alex 脑中闪过四个丈夫、Keller、妻子们、水槽里的 Rebecca；拒绝。
facts.anchor: the faces of the four husbands flashing in her mind. Of Adam Keller. Of the wives.

facts.fact: 章末：「睡个好觉」——「我不一直都这样吗？」
